fx.basis_note: No published EUR/PLN cross-currency basis level was found. Market forward points (1Y ≈ +1.42%/yr EUR→PLN) line up with the OIS gap (€STR OIS 1Y 2.83% vs FX-implied PLN ~4.25%), so the FX-swap basis looks small. The IBOR-based shortcut (WIBOR−EURIBOR 3M) understates the pickup by ~25-35bp because forwards price the expected policy path, not the fixings.
